$schema_note: Partition tree for a new DomainSpec project. AUTHORITY: vault/discovery/system-modeling-partition-architecture/discovery.md (Revision 2026-06-09). If this file and that discovery disagree, the discovery wins and this file is wrong. Consumed by scaffold.py.

fields.name: folder name
fields.owner: shared (framework half) | per-project | mixed — navigational only; NOT enforced (gate-first, OQ-6).
fields.mirrored: true if this node is reproduced inside internal_tools/. The four mirrored:false top-level/knowledge nodes (arcanum, domainspec, system_design_knowledge, internal_tools) are exactly the shared layer a sub-project inherits from its parent.
fields.modality: true for sessions/experiments — a recording modality, not a subject partition; never promoted.
fields.machinery: if 'experiments', scaffold.py copies assets/experiments/{PROTOCOL.md, README.md, _TEMPLATE/, tools/} into this folder.
fields.mirror_root: true only for internal_tools — the node whose body is the mirror of the (mirrored:true) tree.
fields.link_to_framework: true only for domainspec/ — created as a symlink to the framework repo (idempotent; existing mount left alone) so vault/ ontology symlinks resolve through it.
fields.subfolders: list of project-local node-type folders to create as empty dirs + README stubs (vault/, domain_knowledge/).
fields.symlinks: list of {dest, src} — dest is relative to this node's folder, src is relative to domainspec/. Creates a relative symlink (top-level only) routed through the project's domainspec/ mount; skipped-with-warning if the source is missing. Used by vault/ for the read-only ontology canon.
fields.seeds: list of {dest, src} — copies the framework doc at domainspec/<src> in as an EDITABLE project-local starter (top-level only). Used by system_design_knowledge/ for project-specializable dev constitutions.
fields.stub_files: list of {dest, node_type, note} — named placeholder docs with valid frontmatter (e.g. discovery/_backlog.md as backlog; event-system-constitution.md as a constitution stub).

tree.name: arcanum
tree.readme: Executable projection of the method — skills, agents, workflows. Shared framework layer, conventionally carved out under `.claude/**`. Declarative method nodes link here via `operationalized-by` (forward-only).

tree.name: domainspec
tree.readme: The DomainSpec framework. Created as a SYMLINK to the framework repo (local dev) so vault/ ontology symlinks resolve through it; convert to a real git submodule for portability. Read-only in-project (submodule-edit ban). Existing domainspec/ is left untouched (idempotent).

tree.name: schema
tree.readme: Project-LOCAL schema-extension layer (R-6). The BASE ontology contract — the `node_type` set, edge catalog, frontmatter spec, and the `vault_common` validators — ships INSIDE the `domainspec/` submodule and is read-only. This `schema/` is where THIS project records local vocabulary/edge extensions layered over that base. It also carries `code-ontology/` — the canonical L1 code ontology (25 meta-types, 29 typed edges, machine-checkable via validate_ontology.py). A sub-project's own `schema/` extends the same base, inheriting the code ontology from the parent (not cloned).

tree.name: knowledge
tree.readme: Subject-grouped knowledge graphs. Children are partitioned by SUBJECT; ownership (shared vs per-project) is a frontmatter property here, not the path axis (Revision 2026-06-09, R-1 — supersedes the discovery's original ownership-primary D-1).

children.name: system_design_knowledge
children.readme: How the system is built — the reusable method. SEEDED with editable starter dev constitutions (development-practices, folder-structure, frontend, commit-message) COPIED from the framework so the project specializes them per-project; ontology lives in the sibling `vault/`, not here. `event-system` and `robot-talks` are stubs to author per project. (Structured like ../house_project's dev-knowledge; copy-vs-symlink split per the cross-repo-canonicalization constitution.)

stub_files.note: STUB — author per project if the system is event-sourced. The framework's event-system-constitution is architecture-specific and intentionally NOT seeded.
STUB — opt-in multi-agent investigation practice. Seed from the framework's robot-talks-constitution only if the project adopts it.

children.name: domain_knowledge
children.readme: The problem world — the project's OWN typed knowledge graph (its axioms, premises, conceptuals, discoveries, sessions). Authored by the domain expert; starts empty. The `domain_knowledge` of internal_tools is about the tooling's own domain.

children.name: vault
children.readme: Knowledge ABOUT the ontology itself. The canonical ontology docs are SYMLINKED (read-only, single source) from the `domainspec/` submodule — no copies, no drift (your 'symlink the ontology documents' decision). The project authors its OWN axioms/premises/conceptuals/discoveries in the stub folders. Distinct from `schema/` (the enforced contract). Symlinks are top-level only; the internal_tools mirror inherits the ontology from its parent.

stub_files.note: Discovery backlog. Frontmatter-only per convention (no ## Connections).

tree.name: implementation
tree.readme: The system as built — generated/derived code and artifacts. Each implementation node traces back to a knowledge node by `realized-by` (no orphan behavior). INTERIOR GOVERNED by `folder-structure-constitution.md` (v3.0.0): three-layer architecture `/infrastructure -> /domains -> /shared_services`, screaming architecture, layer purity, acyclic imports. This skill creates the slot; the constitution rules the inside (R-5).

tree.name: research
tree.readme: Unresolved exploration — the BIRTHPLACE (R-4). A finding starts here; once it matures it routes to a `knowledge/` partition (system_design_knowledge | domain_knowledge | vault) OR to `implementation/`, lineage preserved by the `derives-from` back-anchor (horizontal routing, not `mv`). There is no separate `decisions/`, `findings/`, or `discoveries/` partition — those are node_types and states living within research/ and knowledge/, not folders.

tree.name: sessions
tree.readme: Time-flat conversation records. A MODALITY, not a subject: `is_session: true`, forward-only edges, NEVER promoted. Flat single files; date-partition only if count exceeds ~1k.

tree.name: experiments
tree.readme: Pre-registered, falsifiable experiments (`node_type: experiment` — a RATIFIED vocabulary value, amendment 2026-06-09). A MODALITY. Each `E<N>-<slug>/` holds PROPOSAL.md (the immutable-once-frozen pre-registration), RUN-NN.md (append-only run log), and VERDICT.md (mechanical adjudication). Full rules in PROTOCOL.md; start from `_TEMPLATE/`.

tree.name: internal_tools
tree.readme: Buildable sub-system (platform tooling) modeled as a NESTED DomainSpec sub-project. Mirrors the per-project tree MINUS the shared framework layer it inherits from the parent — so it carries its own `schema/`, `knowledge/{domain_knowledge, vault}`, `implementation/`, `research/`, `sessions/`, `experiments/`, but NOT `arcanum/`, `domainspec/`, `system_design_knowledge/`, or a nested `internal_tools/`. This recursion is a SCOPED exception (Revision 2026-06-09, R-2); thin nodes are still never inflated to folders.
